Questions.question: Where was Rafiq when his mistake happened?
What tool did Rafiq use too quickly?
What caused Niyas’s readings to become inaccurate?
Questions.answer: Placing the scanner on an unstable stool.
options: Placing the scanner on an unstable desk.
Placing the scanner on an unstable stool.

Questions.question: What did both trainees admit?
options: They forgot to clean the tools.

activity_c.text: Rafiq and Niyas walked up to Mr. Ranjith after the morning toolbox meeting.
Both looked slightly tense, and Rafiq spoke first.
Good morning, Sir, we need to talk to you.
We realised we made a couple of mistakes last week, and we want to explain them properly.
Assalamu Alaikum, both of you. Thank you for being honest.
Let’s go through them one by one.
Rafiq, tell me then , what happened?
I tightened the wheel nuts unevenly.
Where exactly were you when your problem occurred?
I was near the hydraulic lift, right beside the tyre-changing machine.
And when did it happen?
What time was it?
It was Tuesday, around half past nine, just before the inspection round.
Alright.
Now tell me—how did you end up tightening the wheel nuts unevenly?
Sir… I used the impact wrench too quickly.
I should have checked the torque settings first, but I didn’t.
I usually check the settings, but not every day—maybe two or three times a week.
And why didn’t you check them that morning?
Honestly, sir, I assumed the settings were still correct from the previous job.
But now I know that’s not safe.
Good.
So how are you going to make sure it doesn’t happen again?
I’m going to check the torque settings every morning and note them in the maintenance sheet.
I’ll also tighten the nuts in the correct sequence.
Alright.
Now, Niyas, what was your mistake?
The first readings from the digital scanner were inaccurate.
Where were you when your mistake happened?
I was near the engine-bay workbench, right beside the diagnostic scanner.
And when was that?
Thursday around 3.00 p.m., during the engine-tuning session.
And how did the first set of readings become so inaccurate?
Sir, I connected the sensors correctly, but I placed the scanner on the unstable stool, and it kept vibrating.
I also used the older probe set, and the signal became slightly distorted.
Why didn’t you check the probe set?
I was trying to save time, sir.
I check it most of the time, but this time I rushed because another vehicle was waiting.
So, how are you going to avoid these problems next time?
I’m going to secure the scanner on a stable surface, use the newer probe set, and follow the proper tuning sequence.
I’ll also double-check the connections before starting.
Good.
These are small mistakes—not disasters—but they matter.
Let’s be more consistent this week.
